findings.detail: "Acme Corp Sans" is not in our data, so its weights, italics, axes and licence were not checked. That is not a problem in itself.

"Helvetica Neue" is a premium font in our catalogue (Neue Helvetica). Our data holds no licence terms for it; its licence comes from the foundry or vendor you got it from. Catalogue page: https://fontalternatives.com/alternatives/neue-helvetica/?utm_source=webfont-audit&utm_medium=mcp
